content.short: CoinVoyage lets businesses accept non-custodial crypto payments from any token on any chain.
content.description: CoinVoyage is a non-custodial, cross-chain payment solution: customers pay with any token on any chain and the funds go straight to the merchant's wallet, with support for invoices and checkouts. Stable's official ecosystem page lists CoinVoyage.
content.meta: CoinVoyage offers non-custodial, cross-chain crypto payments for businesses, listed on Stable.
